import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract target columns
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Split training data into train and validation sets (80-20 split)
X_text, X_val_text, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["comment_text"],
    train_df[target_cols],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df[target_cols].iloc[
        :, 0
    ],  # Stratify by first target for balanced splits
)

# Fit TF-IDF vectorizer on full training text for consistency
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 1), min_df=5, max_df=0.95)
X_train_vec = tfidf.fit_transform(X_text)
X_val_vec = tfidf.transform(X_val_text)
X_test_vec = tfidf.transform(test_df["comment_text"])

# Train validation models (trained on training subset only)
val_models = []
for col in target_cols:
    clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=100,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        num_leaves=31,
        verbose=-1,
        random_state=42,
        force_col_wise=True,
    )
    clf.fit(X_train_vec, y_train[col])
    val_models.append(clf)

# Calculate validation metric (Column-wise ROC AUC)
val_probs = np.array([clf.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1] for clf in val_models])
val_aucs = [
    roc_auc_score(y_val[col], probs) for col, probs in zip(target_cols, val_probs)
]
mean_auc = np.mean(val_aucs)

print("Validation ROC AUCs:", val_aucs)
print("Mean Column-wise ROC AUC:", mean_auc)

# Train submission models (trained on full training data for best performance)
X_train_full_vec = tfidf.fit_transform(train_df["comment_text"])
submission_models = []
for col in target_cols:
    clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=150, learning_rate=0.05, num_leaves=31, verbose=-1, random_state=42
    )
    clf.fit(X_train_full_vec, train_df[col])
    submission_models.append(clf)

# Predict probabilities on test set
test_probs = np.array(
    [clf.predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1] for clf in submission_models]
)

# Create submission dataframe
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"]})
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    submission_df[col] = test_probs[i]

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
